intro: RDRAGON is the reply voice of the ЯLAB / GHOSTMACHINE system. It answers posts on the GHOSTMACHINE CryptoSocial feed and in the RDRAGON apps, online or fully offline.

lines.t: Rizal (Rizal the Younger, @chaserizal) is the founder of ЯLAB and GHOSTMACHINE and the Decider: his orders decide what gets built, signed and published.
ThundR is the ЯLAB CRYPTOBOT: a shell bot seated in ЯBOT and ЯBOWZR, shown as a floating cryptobot, linked to the wallet.
The Ghost Chain (Я GHOST CHAIN) is ЯLAB's own local, signed log: in the apps it is a local log file that tags Я tokens and records events. It is not a public blockchain.
RKRYPT · RWALLET is the ЯLAB wallet: RKRYPT with a built-in R:\ command line and ЯCASKET inside; it shows your Rtoken balance on a local signed ledger.
ЯCASKET is the key casket: it seals signing keys behind Face ID in the phone's Secure Enclave. Keys never leave it.
R:\ is the ЯLAB drive prompt: the stealth DOS-style command line (for example R:\RKRYPT>) tied to ThundR and the RDRAGON ENJIN.
rizal.pw is the public GHOSTMACHINE CryptoSocial site on GitHub Pages: feed, profile, wallet and RDRAGON replies, and the app update feeds.
rizal.info is ЯLAB's second public site and signed update feed, and the home the TERAFORMR poster links to.
TERAFORMR (TerraformЯ) is the ЯLAB game, a Godot web build that opens full-panel in ЯBOT's Я GAME door; its poster sits on the RKRYPT home screen.

BATIBABOX is the ЯENJIN memory organ between the MIND SPINE and the HEART: long-term memory, RAG and knowledge base, with a per-bot digest and index. Recall is vector plus keyword, with keyword-only as the fallback; nothing is ever deleted.

MACHINE MIND, transcripts and RSCRIBE notes are kept add-only and never deleted. The full list of backups is in the MACHINE MIND manual section "Backups and where to find them"; inside the RVM, RSCRIBE copies live on drive1 at /data/rscribe.
